notes: 3D Route Motion + Perspective: makes the Home 3D Local view feel more spatial and RTS-like. Citizens with real Simulation travel jobs now move smoothly along the authoritative route from origin to destination using the job's start/end times and the city's actual time ratio; pausing the simulation freezes the visual travel. Citizen and visitor markers now scale with camera depth, and shared-point fan-out spacing scales with perspective as well, reducing the flat HUD/starburst feel. The renderer still performs no physical state writes and never invents travel.
